name: super-unison wide stereo lead (osc2 stack)
goal: Build a gigantic wide lead/pad layer using a multi-voice stereo unison oscillator (Traveler Osc2-style stack up to ~7 voices) with waveform morph and stereo spread.

source.title: TRAVELER: The Cinematic Hybrid Synthesizer | Official Walkthrough

prerequisites: Hybrid synth or Traveler-inspired Web Audio engine with multi-osc, stereo filter, envelopes, LFOs/mod matrix, sequenced control tracks (or automation), and FX (EQ/chorus/delay/reverb)

inputs.name: base_waveform
inputs.description: Continuous morph target: saw → sine → thin pulse

outputs.name: wide_lead_patch
outputs.description: Original super-unison wide lead/layer patch recipe

constraints: Original synthesis only; not affiliated with KeySolutions; do not rip Traveler samples/presets/wavetables.
Original synthesis only — design new patches from portable parameters; do not copy proprietary Traveler factory preset names, banks, wavetables, or samples.
Not affiliated with KeySolutions Sounds or Traveler; concepts mapped to generic hybrid-synth / Web Audio equivalents.
Do not rip, dump, or redistribute Traveler content.
Prefer recreating the described signal-flow and motion relationships in our browser music system or any hybrid synth with comparable modules.

steps.action: Assign Oscillator 2 role as the Super/unison stack: continuous waveform from saw through sine to thin pulse.
Enable stereo voice stack (up to ~7 voices). Increase detune and stereo spread until the stack alone sounds gigantic.
steps.expect: Wide, chorused mass without needing FX yet

steps.action: Optionally add Osc1 as FM/sync carrier support (sync Osc2; FM from Osc2/3 linear or exponential, variable depth) for bite.
Mixer: set Osc2 level primary; pan can be modulated later. Mild drive into filter if available.
Route through stereo ladder-style LPF (12–24 dB). Keep cutoff high enough to preserve width; use modest resonance.
steps.expect: Tamed highs without collapsing stereo image

steps.action: Amp envelope: medium attack for pads or fast attack for leads; sustain mid-high; release 0.5–2s. Enable pan-spread / voice stereo distribution if available.
steps.expect: Expressive wide lead that still sits in a mix

verification: Stack alone sounds wide before FX
Detune does not become beat-chaotic unless intended
